record.question: In an Intravenous Urogram (IVU), what is the 'nephrogram phase'?
options: The phase where contrast is collecting in the bladder.
The phase where contrast is being excreted into the ureters.
The phase where contrast is concentrated within the renal parenchyma (kidney tissue).
The phase where a plain radiograph (KUB) is taken before contrast injection.
record.explanation: Answer C: The phase where contrast is concentrated within the renal parenchyma (kidney tissue).. The nephrogram phase is the early phase when contrast opacifies renal parenchyma. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/voidcysto; https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/safety-xray. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
